## 2. Ready-to-paste comment / annotation

a(6)-a(7) computed by an exact self-similar renormalization over the 3-corner boundary of the n-Hanoi graph H_n (H_n = 3 copies of H_(n-1) joined by 3 bridge edges at the extreme corners; the 3 extreme corners are mutually non-adjacent for n>=2, so a bounded per-corner state suffices). The program reproduces every previously listed term exactly, and each new term was independently verified by a second, independently-authored program (a distinct GPT-5 / Codex lineage using its own derivation) that agrees digit-for-digit.
